rows.en: ＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿００１Hi! Sorry for dropping by out of￥the blue! I wanted to talk to￥you about something, Cousin.
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿００２Wow, you're really something,￥Cousin! Before I knew it, you'd￥passed me! What a shock!
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿００３Does that mean you weren't￥really trying until now? Because￥if so, that's kind of insulting.
I always give it my all.
It's not like that...
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿００４Really?￥I see...＝＠１３９＿００５Then I got passed just because￥I wasn't good enough.
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿００６That's how it looked to me,￥at least.
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿００７Sorry, Cousin.
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿００８I never thought the day would￥come when we'd compete over￥grades.＝＠１３９＿００９Kind of happy, kind of sad...￥It's a complicated feeling.
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０１０But you're still the same old￥Cousin I know, right?
We're not kids anymore.
I'll never change.
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０１１Right... you're right.￥We're both grown-ups now.￥It's only natural we've changed.
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０１２I knew it, phew! For some￥reason, I felt like you were￥going far away from me!
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０１３You're you, Cousin.￥And that'll never change,￥not ever!
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０１４Sorry to bother you on your￥day off. I'll try harder on￥the next exam, too.
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０１５If you don't have some￥competition, you won't feel￥motivated either, right, Cousin?
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０１６See you!
